With added stretch and durable elastic, the fitted sheet is designed to stay snug and fitted to your mattress.

Dstense bed sheet sets are also wrinkle and fade resistant to give your bed that fresh new ironed look every single time. And also will be the perfect sanctuary to catch your best night’s sleep.
